lr_fra_defeat_end = {
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_defeat }
	set_variable = { LR_def_stability_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { LR_def_political_power_gain = 0 }
	set_variable = { LR_def_war_support_factor = 0 }
}

lr_fra_heal_defeat = {
	add_to_variable = { LR_def_stability_factor = 0.02 }
	add_to_variable = { LR_def_political_power_gain = 0.02 }
	add_to_variable = { LR_def_war_support_factor = -0.02 }
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_def_stability_factor min = -0.1 max = 0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_def_political_power_gain min = -0.1 max = 0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_def_war_support_factor min = 0 max = 0.1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_def_stability_factor > -0.001 } }
		lr_fra_defeat_end = yes
	}
}

lr_fra_spirits_init = {
	set_variable = { LR_def_stability_factor = -0.1 }
	set_variable = { LR_def_political_power_gain = -0.1 }
	set_variable = { LR_def_war_support_factor = 0.1 }
	set_variable = { LR_dis_army_attack_factor = -0.2 }
	set_variable = { LR_dis_army_defence_factor = -0.1 }
	set_variable = { LR_dis_army_org_factor = -0.1 }
	set_variable = { LR_dis_training_time_factor = 0.2 }
	set_variable = { LR_tech_index = 0 }
	set_variable = { LR_cmd_index = 0 }
	set_variable = { LR_off_index = 0 }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_defeat }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_disarmed }
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_rebuild }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	lr_fra_ruler_louis = yes
}
